rejected.title: Guidance for a rejected workflow template
rejected.reason: The freshly reread post says only that a workflow-template submission was rejected three times and asks for guidance. It supplies no rejection criteria, template task, or repeatable output to scope; this same unchanged excerpt was already assessed in prior decisions, so there is no new primary evidence to justify repeating a scored experiment.
